read_pfm_file: read a PFM file from disk and return the numpy array data and scale value
write_pfm_file: write a float32 numpy array as a PFM file to disk with an optional scale
read_image_rgb: read an image file and return an RGB numpy array normalized to 0-1 range
write_depth_map: write a depth map as both a PFM file and a PNG file with configurable bit depth
write_segmentation_image: write a segmentation overlay image by blending labels with the input image and saving as PNG
